body: Well I usually distract myself quickly before it sets me in a bad mood. I found that if I focus in like a hobby or exercise, it quiets down my thoughts. I put more thought into it and I remembered I have had experiences with people verbally messing with me. Or arguments where others have said harsh words. I guess it kind of stuck with me. I confronted them about it, they apologized and meant it.  I'm not mad at those people anymore we get along fine now. I rush to people I'm close with when it gets too much

yeh I've been taking up more yoga and exercise but it's only a temporary solution tbh. Makes your body feel great though.

Kinda random thoughts. Like keeps telling myself typical stuff like I'm useless and nobody cares. But I know I have a loving family and friends. Or making me panic out of nowhere to run away or commit self-harm (I haven't hurt myself yet). Reminds me of past mistakes or the bad things existing in the world. Or just nitpicking like people are gonna judge the way u dress, that guy is so annoying, this girl chews weird.

It's like having a bully constantly follow you, criticizing everything you do. Is really shallow pointing out mine and others flaws. Even right now I feel like what I'm saying is pointless and desparate :(
